integrity: All universal claims have explicit proofs from Lucas, quadratic reciprocity, CRT, Dirichlet and digit enumeration; finite code tests corroborate but do not prove the infinite assertions. The prior modulus-five residue-set restriction is credited to Vsemirnov.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime character signs at nonzero binomial residues only; no effective prime-density error; finite-block count only for the stated modulus-five shifted family. Potential equivalent coverage in unavailable historical literature.
title: Parity rigidity and exact first-defect laws for central-binomial quadratic characters
